phase: independent confirmation, frozen before confirmation data
orders: lean_study exact reversed block pairs with rotated starting position
selection: Choose candidate after exploratory screens; use disjoint request seeds and fresh full stacks; do not pool screen data

saturation: Repeat selected/reference comparison at C16 near prior measured plateau, same8CPUs; separately interpret it fromC4
